queries.query: Fix the circular import and initialization-order bug in these .mjs modules without changing their public exports.
This browser-side JavaScript sometimes returns before all uploads settle. Repair the async flow and add a regression test.
Fix this .js AbortSignal timeout wrapper so the losing operation cannot keep running or leave listeners installed.
Write a new .js module that loads the dashboard's widgets from three independent endpoints and renders them once all have settled.
Use $javascript-development to review this .cjs utility for coercion and error-handling bugs.
Update the JavaScript Node service so rejected requests cancel outstanding work and shutdown closes the server cleanly.
Refine this TypeScript discriminated union so every reducer branch is exhaustively checked.
Correct the conditional exports and engines range in package.json; no JavaScript source changes are needed.
Adjust the CSS grid breakpoints for the dashboard layout.
